「標準」會找出方言間的語音對應與少量拼寫差異；「精確」只比對拼寫正規化後相同的詞: “Standard” finds cross-dialect sound correspondences (such as a dropped r or final l→n) and small spelling differences; “Exact” only matches identical normalised spellings. Either way, words that start or end with, or contain, what you typed are listed too.
